requirements.title: Say how a run that stopped at the pushed branch ended
requirements.rationale: The controller lands the work, files the open items and starts the next step from this file alone.

criteria.action: for any result document of a `--no-merge` run that got past its refusals, accept it: `skill` is `af-impl`, `mode` is `no_merge`, `outcome` is `complete`, `complete_with_open_items`, `parked`, `gate_failed` or `push_failed`, `package` holds its six members, `branch` and `head` are non-empty strings, `pushed` is a boolean, and `tasks`, `deviations` and `open_items` are lists
criteria.contract: validating the document against the schema returns no error

check.pseudocode: in specification/schemas/af_impl_result_test.go (new), one table of documents the schema accepts, each the base document with a change: {unchanged; a package of status 'draft' and profile 'lite'; outcome 'complete_with_open_items' with open_items [{kind: 'untested', title: 'no test of the retry cap', missing, why, ids: ['REQ-2.3'], evidence: ['retry/budget.go:41'], closes}]; outcome 'parked' with parked {task: 2, output}, tasks of outcomes done, in_progress and pending, and neither summary nor run; outcome 'gate_failed' with gate {level: 'full', verdict: 'fail', commands: [{name: 'all_tests', exit_code: 1, seconds: 3.2, tail}]}; outcome 'push_failed' with pushed false and a reason; outcome 'push_failed' with pushed false, a reason and neither summary nor run; each of refused_branch, refused_dependency, refused_dirty and refused_package with a reason and no package, tasks, deviations, open_items, summary or run; refused_package with a reason and a package of status 'sealed'; refused_dependency with a reason, a package and pushed false}: assert schema.Validate(document) returns no error

criteria.condition: a result document's `outcome` is `refused_branch`, `refused_dependency`, `refused_dirty` or `refused_package` and it carries a non-empty `reason`
criteria.action: accept the document without `package`, `tasks`, `deviations`, `open_items`, `summary` and `run`, with `pushed` either `true` or `false`, and with a `package` of any lifecycle status when it carries one
criteria.contract: validating the document returns no error

criteria.condition: a result document lacks `skill`, `mode`, `outcome`, `branch`, `head` or `pushed`, or its `skill` is not `af-impl`, its `mode` is not `no_merge`, its `outcome` is none of `complete`, `complete_with_open_items`, `parked`, `gate_failed`, `push_failed`, `refused_branch`, `refused_dependency`, `refused_dirty` and `refused_package`, its `branch` or `head` is empty, its `pushed` is not a boolean, or it carries a member the schema does not name
criteria.contract: validating the document returns an error whose text names the member that is missing, wrong or unknown

criteria.condition: a result document's `outcome` begins `refused_` or is `push_failed` and it has no `reason`, or an empty one
criteria.contract: validating the document returns an error that names `reason`

criteria.condition: a result document's `outcome` is `complete`, `complete_with_open_items`, `parked`, `gate_failed` or `push_failed` and it lacks `package`, `tasks`, `deviations` or `open_items`, or its `package.status` is neither `draft` nor `active`, or its `outcome` is `complete`, `complete_with_open_items` or `gate_failed` and it lacks `summary` or `run`
criteria.contract: validating the document returns an error that names the missing or wrong member

criteria.condition: a result document's `outcome` is `complete` and its `open_items` is not empty, or its `outcome` is `complete_with_open_items` and its `open_items` is empty
criteria.contract: validating the document returns an error that names `open_items`

criteria.condition: a result document's `outcome` is `complete`, `complete_with_open_items`, `parked` or `gate_failed` and its `pushed` is `false`, or its `outcome` is `push_failed` and its `pushed` is `true`
criteria.contract: validating the document returns an error that names `pushed`

criteria.condition: a result document's `outcome` is `parked` and it has no `parked` member holding a `task` of at least 1 and an `output`, or its `outcome` is `gate_failed` and it has no `gate`, or its `outcome` is `complete` or `complete_with_open_items` and it carries a `gate` whose `verdict` is not `pass`
criteria.contract: validating the document returns an error that names `parked` or `gate`

requirements.title: Carry the record a merge commit would have held
requirements.rationale: Without a merge commit, the tasks, the deviations and the gate's numbers have no other place a caller can read them from.

criteria.action: for any result document whose `tasks`, `deviations`, `run` and `gate` are as a run writes them, accept it: a task entry holds `number`, at least 1, and `outcome`, one of `done`, `dropped`, `in_progress` and `pending`, and a `done` one also `commit` and `verdict`, one of `pass`, `pass_baseline_failing`, `regressed`, `still_failing` and `gate_failed`; a deviation holds `key`, `reason` and `adr`; `run` holds `gate` and `open_items`; `gate` holds `verdict` and `commands`
criteria.contract: validating the document returns no error, and a `gate` object may carry members of `speca`'s gate answer the schema does not name

requirements.title: List every open item with its kind
requirements.rationale: Whoever lands the work files the open items; an entry that lacks its kind, its severity or the package it awaits cannot be labelled.

criteria.action: for any open item that holds `kind`, one of `awaits`, `defect`, `untested` and `deviation`, a `title` of 1 to 60 characters, `missing`, `why`, a non-empty list `ids`, a list `evidence` and `closes`, with `severity`, one of `security`, `data-loss`, `correctness` and `minor`, on a `defect` and on no other kind, `awaits`, a package id, on an `awaits` item and on no other kind, and `adr` where there is one, accept the document that lists it
criteria.contract: validating the document returns no error
